author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Dartmouth women’s rugby went into halftime tied with Life University on Saturday before the Running Eagles pulled away for a 49-22 victory in Hanover. The final score ended a competitive opening half in which the Big Green stayed level with a nationally prominent opponent before Life created a decisive margin after the break.

The result was posted by Dartmouth Athletics along with postgame interviews from head coach Katie Dowty and Vasiti Turagavou. Life’s 27-point winning margin reflects how sharply the match changed in the second half, after Dartmouth had matched the visitors through the first 40 minutes. The contest was one of the Big Green’s first home tests of the fall schedule.

For Dartmouth, the takeaway is the contrast between a balanced first half and the pressure Life applied after halftime. The Big Green now have a clear benchmark as the season moves forward: sustain the structure and physical response that kept Saturday’s match even, while limiting the stretches that allowed the Running Eagles to build distance on the scoreboard.
dek: The Big Green reached halftime level with the Running Eagles before Life created separation in the second half in Hanover.
headline: Life University pulls away from Dartmouth women’s rugby, 49-22
